### Are You Hated Like Jesus is Hated?
Author: Lynette Kittle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/are-you-hated-like-jesus-is-hated-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: John 15:18
Points:
- Experiencing universal approval from the culture can signal an unhealthy compromise with worldly values.
- Jesus explicitly prepared His disciples for rejection by reminding them He was hated first.
- Hostility faced by faithful believers is fundamentally a rejection of God and His truth.
- Christians are called to stand firm on biblical convictions even when culture calls evil good.

### The World’s Hatred
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/worlds-hatred
Passage: John 15:18–21
Points:
- Being chosen by Christ brings salvation but also guarantees opposition from the world.
- The "world" represents humanity in sustained rebellion against God and His kingdom.
- Servants cannot expect greater acceptance from a world that despised their Master.
- Never encountering friction or hostility may reveal a failure to live faithfully for the gospel.
